fusions.name: Squall Barrage
fusions.desc: Looses 5 streams of rain at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Puddle Stomp
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A wet kick that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds and has a 60% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Washed Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Smell of Storm
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by something other than fire, you gain a ward that absorbs 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
